steps.text: Answer the Hokage's summons in his office, at the top of the residence

dialogue.speaker: hiruzen
dialogue.text: You're one of the new genin, aren't you? I'm sorry to call on you on your first night as a shinobi.

dialogue.speaker: hiruzen
dialogue.text: Naruto has taken the Scroll of Seals, a scroll of forbidden techniques. Everyone is searching for him.

dialogue.speaker: hiruzen
dialogue.text: Check the training ground west of the Academy. And be careful.

steps.text: Search Training Ground 3, west of the Academy

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: You... get out of here! Mizuki's the one who tricked Naruto. He wants the scroll for himself!

dialogue.speaker: mizuki
dialogue.text: Oh? One of the little genin. Do you know why the whole village hates Naruto? Shall I tell you?

dialogue.speaker: mizuki
dialogue.text: No? Then you can fall here with Iruka.

choices.text: Naruto is my classmate. I won't let you.

dialogue.speaker: naruto
dialogue.text: Lay one finger on Iruka-sensei and I'll take you down! Multi Shadow Clone Jutsu!

dialogue.speaker: naruto
dialogue.text: Heh heh... I guess I got a little carried away. You okay?

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: Naruto, come here. Close your eyes... There. Congratulations. You graduate too.

steps.text: Report to the Hokage in his office

dialogue.speaker: hiruzen
dialogue.text: The scroll is safe, and Naruto is a genin. You did well tonight, standing beside your classmates.

dialogue.speaker: hiruzen
dialogue.text: Rest now. Tomorrow you'll be placed in your squad.
